title: A repair cut lost to a stream break before its diff arrives leaves the repair-delta commit uncovered
outcome: A repair cut lost to a stream break before its diff arrives leaves the repair-delta commit uncovered
acceptance: A repair cut requested but not yet covered by an adopted stateDiff or marked full state at or above its revision is repaired over HTTP (/api/state with forceAdoptEqualOrNewerRevision at that revision) when a stream continuity break voids the diff baseline

A deterministic UI test covers: repair cut requested, stream error before any covering diff, HTTP repair requested for that revision; and a covering diff adopted before the break requests no HTTP repair
